reason: Virtual sneakers you repair and upgrade with points, plus gacha pulls, is exactly the StepN loop that cost me money in 2022, and points I can't cash out are pointless to me anyway. My current app already tracks my Han River runs, so I don't need this.
objection: It looks like a move-to-earn game wearing a running-crew costume; today the points can't be cashed out, but the sneaker-and-token design makes me think that could change and I'd get pulled back into the same trap.
would_change_my_mind: If my running crew all moved to it for the crew runs and I could switch off the sneaker and points part entirely, so it's just a GPS and crew-run app.
